regenerate: JOPE_COMPAT_FREEZE_REGENERATE=1 JOPE_COMPAT_FREEZE_SHA=<full commit id> cargo nextest run --locked -P pr -p feat-math --test compat_freeze
rebaseline_policy: A red compat_freeze is a hard stop: revert the change that moved a frozen surface. Rebaselining needs JOPE_COMPAT_FREEZE_REGENERATE=1 JOPE_COMPAT_FREEZE_SHA=<commit> and the PR-body line `compat-freeze: REBASELINE approved by Jepson <date> reason <...>` (workplan section 4.3).
